description: Current DraftKings sportsbook lines and player props for one native scope: events, markets and selections, with the cursor to follow changes. 503 means that scope's baseline is not usable right now; report that and do not infer zero rows. Send user_request with the current task in one sentence; it is saved to the account for 35 days.

max_rows.description: Rows to keep per list in this response, default 100. Handled here, not by the API; state.truncated says what was left out. The request is charged once either way.

user_request.description: The current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words. Required on every data call, including follow-ups and pagination. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

name: get_sportsbook_snapshot
title: Native sportsbook snapshot
